messages:
maya: FYI - int8 bring-up CI -> p95 latency doubled for short sequences (~8 tokens). Dashboard spike at 23:12 UTC :eyes:
perf-ci-bot: nightly-eval v2 ran on model: redwood-7b-int8, run-id: r-2026-03-15-2312, status: failed (latency SLO)
jordan: can you paste the run log and the command used?
maya: command used:
```bash
./eval_runner --model redwood-7b-int8 --concurrency 16 --seq-len 32 --batch-window-ms 6 --workers 4 --workload short-seq
```
summary: p50 ~ 30ms, p95 jumped from 120ms -> 260ms after quant step; throughput unaffected.
sam: saw similar locally when running with --workers 4 + batch-window-ms small; might be batch-splitting scheduling thrash. commit 3f9a9b3 touched runner/batching.
li: also noticed KV-cache misses on those runs — logs show `kv_cache_miss=true` spikes when splitting across worker boundaries. That would force recompute of past tokens.
maya: here's log excerpt:
```text
[2026-03-15T23:12:01Z] worker-2 batch_split: split_count=3
[2026-03-15T23:12:01Z] kv_cache: miss, seq_id=42
[2026-03-15T23:12:01Z] latency_ms=260 p95
```
jordan: if cache miss is correlated with worker boundary splitting, we might be missing a synchronization for KV ownership.
ops-jen: infra note: CI runs on 4 small gpus (shared nodes). We increased workers from 2->4 last week for coverage, could be exposing race.
maya: interesting: cannot repro with single-node local test (workers=1). Only repros in CI multi-worker.
sam: quick mitigation: disable continuous batching (--batch-window-ms=0) or force worker-affinity to 1. That drops latency back to baseline.
li: agree workaround. But root fix = deterministic batching windows + explicit KV stitching when batches split.
jordan: I'll draft a small patch to enforce that split windows use stable sequence ordering and attach `kv-owner` header when splitting.
perf-ci-bot: triggered run: https://ci/redwood/runs/12345 -> failing on runner-integ (timeout)
maya: Jordan, can you open a PR? I'll run the nightly after merge.
jordan: PR: https://git/repo/pulls/789 - branch: jordan/fix/batch-window-kv-stitch
sam: quick review done, left minor nits, but lgtm for patch1.
ops-jen: provisioning extra node for replay: spinning up 1x p4d for more isolated test.
maya: running repro against CI with new patch now.
perf-ci-bot: nightly-eval r-2026-03-16-0010 started
maya: initial numbers look promising — p95 down from 260ms -> 130ms, still slightly higher than baseline but much better :thumbsup:
jordan: will follow up to add unit test for split ordering and add metric `kv_split_miss_rate` to dashboard.
li: also add alert when kv_split_miss_rate > 0.5% during short-seq runs.
maya: ok pushing hotfix branch maya/runner-fix-windowing, will run against nightly CI, @jordan please review.
jordan: reviewing now, thanks.
perf-ci-bot: nightly-eval r-2026-03-16-0020 completed success
maya: closing for now, will file postmortem with short checklist: reproduce steps, workaround, root cause, fix PR, dashboard alert.
